newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bonds breaks records, despite U.S. absence.
newsitem.headline: German bonds breaks records, despite U.S. absence.

text.p: The December Bund future ended trade on Thursday on a contract high and an all-time high of 101.70 points, while the Bobl future also entered record territory at 104.99.
Dealers said that local dealers on London's LIFFE exchange helped boost the Bund future to new highs, even though volumes were low because of the Thanksgiving holiday in the U.S.

They said that the outlook for the German debt market was positive and that the upward trend was still intact and optimism was lifted by what they called the helpful fundamental situation, leading to hopes of a year-end rally.
